about.body:
Before this was about photography and creative, I spent years on the label side in digital and PR. I bring that experience to every campaign and project.

I shoot concerts, portraits and campaigns for artists and brands, whether that's photography or short-form content. Content that holds up across platforms, and serves the over-arching strategy.
